blocking_items.finding: Inner-OOF is incomplete. Each inner model must fit scaler, answer/claim weights and class balance from its three inner-training folds only; current outer-training wording permits leakage. Threshold candidates, >= versus >, metric weights, AP implementation/ties and single-class behavior are unfrozen.
blocking_items.required_resolution: Freeze these rules before evaluator code or label access.

blocking_items.finding: PROTOCOL says answer AP relative to P2 is “不低于0.01”, while PLAN permits a drop up to 0.01. Exact-rate denominator is unspecified.
blocking_items.required_resolution: State P3-P2 >= -0.01 (or intended alternative) and exact_count/3776 with invalids counted non-exact.

blocking_items.finding: Existing audited Lookback hooks are no-cache full-sequence replay hooks and reject past_key_value; P3 declares KV-cache generation. Protocol does not choose cache-aware hooks versus post-generation replay and gives no numeric replay tolerance/oracle.
blocking_items.required_resolution: Freeze one path, post-read alignment, oracle and numeric tolerances before smoke.

blocking_items.finding: Literal prompt begins <s>, but add_special_tokens=False is not frozen. SentencePiece incremental decode cannot safely be concatenated token by token; exact byte stop/content intervals need an algorithm. Invalid no-close relation context is undefined.
blocking_items.required_resolution: Freeze tokenizer flags, full-prefix byte reconstruction/stop method and invalid relation context.

blocking_items.finding: P0 lacks exact raw matrix/index hashes and proof that global standardization is absent. Fold weights/scaler/solver behavior are not explicit here.
blocking_items.required_resolution: Lock raw P0 artifacts and apply fold-local preprocessing/training; never reuse in-sample scores.

blocking_items.finding: The taint boundary is correct on paper, but the sanitized manifest/lineage and runner do not yet exist. fit.jsonl contains labels and cannot be a GPU input.
blocking_items.required_resolution: CPU-build, hash and independently audit the allowlist manifest; GPU runner accepts only it and fails closed.

non_blocking_limitations.finding: No “insufficient evidence” hint exists, but the prompt presupposes support. Source-exactness proves provenance, not entailment.
P2/P3 share model, prompt and 549-D schema, but teacher forcing versus greedy generation changes quote text and trajectory; interpret only as an end-to-end condition contrast.
P1→P2 measures whitebox gain for mechanical quotes. No generated-quote surface-only control means P3 gain cannot alone prove its whitebox block caused the gain.
PCA is label-free and shaped 64x4096 but was fitted on original-answer states; quote-state projection is out of distribution.
Serial decoding and Python hooks may exceed the 1.5-3x factor; smoke must report throughput/peak memory without tuning science parameters.

execution_decision.reason: Resolve B1-B6 and audit manifest/runner first.
